  {"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_multiline_string","line":346,"var":"lexer->pos","code":"if (!strncmp(lexer->pos, end, 3)) { emit(lexer, LEXEME_STRING); lexer->pos += 3; }","note":"If the terminator is missing, the loop advances until the end of the mapped file."},
